description: Known-compatible Comfy3D lockset for ComfyUI core and custom-node revisions. Keep nodes that import ComfyUI internals pinned here and refresh through CI before publishing images.

ComfyUI-UniRig.compatibility_note: Includes the opt-in SkinTokensRigGLB node and isolated worker; SkinTokens GPU inference is unqualified on AMD64 and ARM64. Prior baseline validation with ComfyUI 0.34.2 and comfy-aimdo 0.4.15 on native Linux ARM64 covered lazy Linear checkpoint loading, texture-preserving near-target MIA rigging, and isolated Blender 5.2.1 export, not SkinTokens. Keep AMD64 and ARM64 Dockerfile pins synchronized with this ref.

ComfyUI-LTXVideo.compatibility_note: Required for newer ComfyUI Lightricks API: supports freqs_cis_matrix fallback after interleaved_freqs_cis/split_freqs_cis removal. Older ref 531512f7286963dc7aff1fd8bf5556e95eae03af fails import on current ComfyUI master. The current upstream also imports pad from kornia.geometry.transform.pyramid; patch it to torch.nn.functional.pad for newer Kornia.
